C-CALIBRATION-CONTEXT.Summary: Phase 9 round 4 (A63 corr 165): derive calibration context class by join at fold (taskKind, adapterPresence, wroteVsRead, sequentialVsParallel), store it with the pair, bucket the report by context class, prove authored context is rejected/ignored. This change's own fold is the second genuine fold-time pair, carrying stored context.
C-CALIBRATION-CONTEXT.Problem: §9.5.3 and §9.6 require context derived not authored, and §9.5.4 requires the report bucketed by context class. Rounds 1–3 closed ordinal, join, fold-time labels, and adjudicatedAt provenance, but never built context derivation. Corpus-status buckets (included/excluded/pending/backfilled) are not context classes. Context must be stored at fold — deriving later re-reads a moved tree (same class of defect as 156/160).

Goals.Goal: Four dimensions derived by join from ledger and plan; none authored on claims.
Context stored on CalibrationAdjudication at fold; report reads storage only.
Report groups included pairs by context class; section visible at N=0 and N=1.
A7.2 both directions on each dimension in tests.
Authored context attributes rejected on write and ignored if present on disk at fold.
This change's fold writes a real CalibrationAdjudication with contextClass (A46.4).
§9.5/§9.6 table complete with no unamended gap; phase COMPLETE only then.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not edit archived C-CALIBRATION or C-CALIBRATION-PROVENANCE ledgers.
Do not hand-write this change's CalibrationAdjudication; fold must write it.
claimedConfidence remains write-only; no gate may consume it or context class.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Authority axis and anchor precision (still deferred).
Held-out calibration study or gate consumption of confidence/context.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-DERIVED: All four dimensions derived at fold from plan/ledger/write-evidence/allocations.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-NOT-AUTHORED: Authored context attributes rejected on write surface; ignored if present on claim events at fold.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-STORED: CalibrationAdjudication carries taskKind, adapterPresence, wroteVsRead, sequentialVsParallel, contextClass.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPORT-BUCKETED: Report byContextClass groups included pairs; visible at N=1 with one class one row.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BOTH-DIRECTIONS: Tests cover both values for each of the four dimensions.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REAL-FOLD: This change's fold writes CalibrationAdjudication with context; doctor shows it.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SECTION-TABLE: §9.5 and §9.6 table reported with no unamended gap.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green; root lint 0/0.
